narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Six slots of twenty six letters each. That makes one hundred fifty six passwords.
<bookmark mark='two'/>The first two slots alone give twenty six times twenty six, which is six hundred seventy six.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each new slot multiplies the count, so we cannot add the slots up.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 26 × 6 = 156; the two slots alone already show 26 × 26 = 676 choices; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Count the choices in one slot, and raise it to the number of slots.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A cycle lock has three rings, each with the five letters from eigh to e. How many codes can it make?
